property.name: data.name
property.description: This is the name of the datatype, which distinguishes it from other types for the purposes of ingest processing and perhaps even for dataflow/transport concerns

property.name: myparquet.output.name
property.description: This is the name to use on the data in Accumulo

property.name: myparquet.handler.classes
property.description: List of classes that should process each event

property.name: myparquet.data.separator
property.description: Separator between configuration file parameters with multiple values. Parquet records themselves are not delimited text

property.name: myparquet.data.header
property.description: Optional. Known fields expected in every record. Omit this property to accept every column in the Parquet schema

property.name: myparquet.data.process.extra.fields
property.description: If true, columns outside the configured header are processed too

property.name: myparquet.data.parquet.field.name.delimiter
property.description: Delimiter used to join the path of nested Parquet groups into one field name, e.g. ADDRESS_CITY

property.name: myparquet.data.parquet.field.name.uppercase
property.description: Upper case the column names found in the Parquet schema

property.name: myparquet.data.category.marking.visibility.field
property.description: Known field in every record that will contain the event's ColumnVisibility for Accumulo

property.name: myparquet.data.category.marking.default
property.description: ColumnVisibility expression to be applied to each field when the raw data provides none

property.name: myparquet.data.category.date
property.description: Known date field to be used, if found, for the shard row id. Otherwise, current date will be used

property.name: myparquet.data.category.index
property.description: List of known fields to index

property.name: myparquet.data.category.index.reverse
property.description: List of known fields to reverse index

property.name: myparquet.data.default.normalization.failure.policy
property.description: For field normalization failures: DROP, LEAVE, FAIL
